QUEBECFORD HOTELTON ROMEOFORD

Incident page for this loss

Name: MAJ Hotelton Romeoford Quebecford
Reason: aircraft lost or crashed
Unit: 20 HS
Status: Killed In Action from a loss on 03/31/1967; duty: Pilot.
Service: U.S. Air Force; regular component
Country: Laos
Aircraft: UH-1F tail number 65-07932
Short Summary: Hit by 12.7 mm fire while hovering to lower ammunition on the hoist to a recon team.
Primary cause: 12.7 MM
Burial information: SAMPLE MEMORIAL PARK, ANYTOWN
Additional information about this casualty: He was hit while the aircraft hovered over the team, and died before reaching the aid station.
